page.overview:
Who is Mouthto Mouthyan?

Mouthto Mouthyan is a citizen of Dressrosa.

Mouthyan is a young, blonde man who wears a blue shirt. Because of Kyuin, he ended with a large lipstick mark over his face.

Not much is known about Mouthyan's personality, although he was kind enough to warn Vito of his "attacker".

Mouthyan was one of the many men who ended up victim to Kyuin's drunken kissing rampage. Thinking Lola could have been responsible for it, Vito was given directions of the attacker by Mouthyan, but ended up finding that the source of the commotion was someone else.
